chatApp.source: One active QQ group, 2026-09-28, its members only (bots left out): 165 typed messages in 127 turns. A turn is one person's messages no more than 60 s apart; pictures and stickers are not typed. Counts only, no content kept.

answerToAt.source: Same group and day: how long a member took to answer a line that @'d them, when they answered within 10 minutes (19 answers); she answered after 3 s at the median then.

nextInARow.source: Same group and day: seconds between a member's messages sent in a row (54 pairs).
